Name: OpenXLR
Description: Wave Link-style control for OpenXLR: visual level keys, mixer dials, routing, effects, monitoring, and live meters.
Author: Emanuele Sparvoli

Actions.Name: Mixer Key
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle routing, monitoring, mute, hardware controls, profiles, or audio effects with live state

Actions.Name: Visual Level
Actions.Tooltip: Show a live fader and meter; mute, set, or adjust a channel, mix, or device level

Actions.Name: Mixer Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Adjust live channel, mix, device, and audio-effect levels; stack and reorder several controls
